steps.title: Rain or shine · 1
steps.note: Weather often uses a neuter adjective: šalta (cold), šilta (warm), gražu (beautiful). A feeling uses dative: man šalta (I feel cold). Lyja means “it is raining”; sninga means “it is snowing”.
